West Bengal announces welfare package for tea garden workers

The West Bengal government has announced a welfare package amounting to Rs 313.30 crore for tea garden workers. The allocation includes specific provisions for children in tea plantations. This initiative aims to support the livelihoods and well-being of workers in the state's tea industry.
